southparkcommons-longshot:rippling:04944.description: Who are we? Longshot Space Technologies is at the cutting edge of low-cost space access and hypersonics. We are developing a novel space launch system that accelerates mass over a long distance. Using our technology, we plan to provide affordable launch services for satellites, cargo, and future space infrastructure. Our mission is to enable a future where humans don't just reach for the stars, but hold them in the palm of our hands. Position Overview We are hiring an Avionics Engineer to own the vehicle's entire electronics stack from architecture through flight. You'll be the technical authority on everything avionics: flight computer, C&DH, sensor suite, RF and telemetry, power, and flight-termination systems. You'll also own the HIL/SIL test bed and the environmental and g-load qualification that proves it all survives a gun launch. With full end-to-end ownership, you'll design electronics that withstand 250g and function through hypersonic flight, build and test them yourself, and move at a pace no large aerospace company can match. If you want to get your hands dirty alongside specialized engineers building something that hasn't been done before, this is the role. Job Details Role Type: Full-time, Exempt Compensation: $150,000 – $190,000 Annual Salary Location: Onsite in Alameda, CA Key Responsibilities Vehicle avionics architecture: Flight computer / C&DH, avionics stack selection, and downlink protocol, from concept through CDR, qualification, and flight. Flight electronics for a gun-launched environment: Board design, component selection, and packaging that survive in-barrel acceleration and hypersonic flight. The vehicle sensor suite and instrumented projectile: Sensor selection, signal conditioning, data acquisition, and onboard data handling. RF / TT&C / communications: Telemetry downlink, antenna integration (through the waverider geometry and plasma sheath), link-budget analysis, and FCC / NTIA spectrum coordination. The vehicle power system: Battery chemistry selection and gun-hardened qualification, plus power distribution and conditioning. Flight-termination (FTS) avionics: Support of FAA/AST range-safety qualification. The HIL/SIL test bed. Build and own the hardware/software-in-the-loop bench for avionics and GNC integration. Environmental and g-load qualification: Plan and run 250g in-barrel and thermal-cycling test campaigns; reduce and interpret the data. Ground and test instrumentation: Support the active test campaigns (Side Injection, Tonopah) with sensors and data acquisition. Technical documentation: Clear, maintained records of avionics architecture, interfaces, and qualification results. Required Qualifications BS in Electrical, Computer, or Electronics Engineering (or a related field); MS a plus. Equivalent hands-on avionics experience will be considered. 2+ years designing and delivering electronics or avionics in aerospace, defense, or a comparable high-performance, high-reliability hardware environment. Deep embedded/firmware experience. C/C++, RTOS or bare-metal, microcontrollers, and board bring-up. Strong PCB design and layout. Schematic capture and multilayer board layout (Altium, KiCad, or equivalent), including design for manufacture. Hands-on lab proficiency. Soldering, harness/cabling, and bench debug with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and power supplies. U.S. Person status (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident) required for access to export-controlled technical data. Able to work onsite in Alameda, CA, with periodic travel to test sites during campaigns. Preferred Qualifications: RF, communications, or telemetry experience. Link-budget analysis, antenna integration, transceivers, and spectrum coordination. Power electronics and battery systems, including high-g or gun-hardened qualification. voyfai-voyfai:ashbyhq:5f9c1d12-2ed9-4153.description: JOIN VOYFAI, A FAST-GROWING SERIES A STARTUP SHAPING THE FUTURE OF LOGISTICS AND TECHNOLOGY ACROSS EUROPE. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate at the center of a broader group of companies active across several European markets. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership from day one, drive meaningful impact and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Whether you're shaping processes, building strategies or leading initiatives, your contributions will directly influence the success of Voyfai and the companies we support. If you're passionate about building from scratch and excited to be part of a company on the rise, we'd love to hear from you. YOUR ROLE: You lead product implementation at our acquired freight forwarders across Europe and Asia. Most weeks you are onsite next to operators across our European portfolio, finding why our tools (Compass, Customs, Hub) get dropped, and removing the reason in the product or in the process. Six months in, the companies you onboarded run on Voyfai every day without thinking about it. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Sit with operators onsite every week, find the moments where Voyfai gets in the way, and fix it onsite. A wrong status mapping, a missing Compass view, an SOP that does not exist yet, a templated email to add. Most of it ships the same day. - Scope bigger work for engineering when it cannot be fixed onsite. A bug in Hub breaking the daily reporting flow, a niche HS code the AI keeps misclassifying. You reproduce, narrow down, write the brief, and hand it to engineering with everything they need to act fast. - Drive the design of new MVPs with portfolio companies and engineering. A pricing desk wanting to automate rate request intake from email. You run the discovery, agree what is in and what is out, and stay close until the first drafts are landing in operators' hands. - Lead integrations with each new acquisition's existing systems. A TMS we have not seen before, an Outlook setup that is different, a customs flow nobody documented. You scope what flows where, in what format, on what schedule, and stay on the project with engineering until real shipments flow through clean. - Build operator trust in our AI features. Sit with the operations manager for two days, go through every shipment the AI got right and every one it got wrong, until he stops second-guessing. Then turn that into training material for the next company we onboard. - Push usage. Look at the data every week, find who is not adopting, go there in person, ask why, and remove the reason. Over time, become one of the voices engineering listens to when deciding what to build next. WHAT YOU BRING: - 5+ years of experience either inside freight forwarding operations (forwarder, customs broker, or operations lead), or in a customer-facing role at a logistics SaaS or digital freight company (Forto, Project44, Container Xchange, Flexport, or similar). Either way, you know what the work feels like. - A track record of taking implementations from kickoff to live. Not specs, not handoffs. Real systems that people rely on every day, even when the people did not want the new tool in the first place. - The instinct and patience to push back on operators when their request is wrong for the product, and to translate engineering decisions into something operators will actually use. - Comfort using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar in your daily work.
